target_buyer.organization: 211 Ashtabula County / United Way of Ashtabula County
target_buyer.why_top_candidate: Primary resource database for Ashtabula County connecting residents to food pantries, utility assistance, rent assistance, and social services. 24/7 live operators. Digital navigation platform would complement call center operations and expand self-service access.

brandkit_for_mvp.proposed_tagline: Navigate Benefits. Find Help. Get Support.
brandkit_for_mvp.positioning: The digital benefits navigation platform for 211 Ashtabula County — expanding their 24/7 helpline with self-service tools for SNAP, Medicaid, WIC, and rental assistance.

visual_direction.hero_image_concept: Diverse community members accessing resources via phone and digital platforms
visual_direction.color_scheme: Professional blue with warm orange accents (trust + warmth)

implementation_recommendations.brand_alignment: Align with 211's helpful, accessible, 24/7 service mission
key_features_needed: Multi-benefit eligibility screener (SNAP, Medicaid, WIC, LIHEAP)
